population-transition-model.alt: Demographic transition model in four stages. Stage 1 preindustrial: crude birth and death rates both near 40 per 1,000, little growth. Stage 2 transitional: the death rate falls to about 12 while the birth rate stays near 40, so the gap (natural increase, shaded) is widest. Stage 3 industrial: the birth rate falls from about 32 to 12 and the gap narrows. Stage 4 postindustrial: both rates low, about 11 and 10, little growth.
